texte: Number one, it's called trigeminal neuralgia. Like cluster headaches, it's something that has made people say [music] they'd rather die than experience the pain again. The NHS writes, "People with the condition may experience attacks of pain regularly for days, weeks, or months at a time. In severe cases, attacks might happen hundreds of times a day. This is why they make life so unbearable because they keep coming back and they can't be cured. They're caused when something called the trigeminal nerve is compressed by [music] a blood vessel.
